description: This file defines the SettingsForm class, a GUI window for configuring application settings in the RomRaider project. It includes UI components, event handling, and methods to load, apply, and save user preferences related to table display, colors, file associations, and other options.

classes.name: SettingsForm
classes.description: A JFrame subclass providing a GUI for user configuration of application settings, including color schemes, table display options, file associations, and UI preferences.

methods.name: SettingsForm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the form, loading current settings, and setting up event listeners.

methods.name: initSettings
methods.description: Loads current settings into UI components.

methods.name: initComponents
methods.description: Initializes all UI components and layout.

methods.name: initTabs
methods.description: Sets up tabbed panels within the settings window.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles mouse click events on color labels and buttons, opening color choosers or applying/saving settings.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Reads UI component states and updates the Settings object accordingly.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves current settings to persistent storage.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Saves provided Settings object and refreshes UI.

methods.name: drawVisibleTables
methods.description: Redraws all visible tables in the editor.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse pressed event.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse released event.

methods.name: mouseEntered
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse entered event.

methods.name: mouseExited
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse exited event.
